name: Fetch SMS
description: Rent dedicated US numbers, purchase short-term service verifications, poll received codes and messages, extend rentals, and check wallet funds. Messages are delivered for services supported by the Fetch SMS catalogue.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Fetch SMS API key created on the dashboard API page. Enter the key without the Bearer prefix.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read the API-key-accessible wallet balance in integer US cents.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the public service catalogue, current prices in cents, and stock. Use returned numeric service IDs in subsequent requests.

tools.name: list_area_codes
tools.description: List available US area codes for short-term or long-term numbers.

service.description: Service numeric ID from list_services. A service slug is also accepted.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Quote the full price in integer US cents before buying. Long-term mode uses service=1 and requires days.

service.description: Service numeric ID from list_services. A service slug is also accepted.

days.description: Rental term in days. Required for long-term quotes, purchases, and extensions.

custom_area_code.description: Include the custom area-code surcharge. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_verification
tools.description: Reserve a billed number for a supported service in a 15-minute verification window. Poll get_verification every 2-5 seconds for a code.

service.description: Service numeric ID from list_services. A service slug is also accepted.

area_code.description: Optional three-digit US area code. Adds the provider area-code surcharge.

tools.name: list_verifications
tools.description: List your active or finished short-term verifications.

tab.description: Active numbers or completed history. Defaults to active.

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Read a verification and its latest code. Poll every 2-5 seconds until status is received or the verification ends.

verification_id.description: Verification ID returned by create_verification or list_verifications.

tools.name: list_verification_messages
tools.description: Read all verification codes received during an owned verification window, newest first.

verification_id.description: Verification ID returned by create_verification or list_verifications.

tools.name: cancel_verification
tools.description: Cancel a waiting verification and request its refund. The provider rejects cancellation after a code arrives.

verification_id.description: Verification ID returned by create_verification or list_verifications.

tools.name: reuse_verification
tools.description: Purchase a new verification window on the same number and service as an eligible finished verification. The provider checks availability and reuse eligibility.

verification_id.description: Verification ID returned by create_verification or list_verifications.

tools.name: create_rental
tools.description: Purchase a dedicated long-term US number for all supported catalogue services. The entire rental price is charged up front.

service.description: Long-term Unlimited product. Use numeric ID 1 or unlimited-services.

days.description: Rental term in days. Required for long-term quotes, purchases, and extensions.

area_code.description: Optional three-digit US area code. Adds the provider area-code surcharge.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.description: List owned long-term rentals, newest first.

tab.description: Active numbers or completed history. Defaults to active.

limit.description: Maximum number of rentals to return. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: get_rental
tools.description: Read an owned rental and its last_code. Poll every 2-5 seconds for supported-service messages.

rental_id.description: Rental ID returned by create_rental or list_rentals.

tools.name: list_rental_messages
tools.description: Read delivered messages for an owned rental, including full text and extracted codes, newest first.

rental_id.description: Rental ID returned by create_rental or list_rentals.

tools.name: extend_rental
tools.description: Add a billed term to an active rental while retaining its number. Extensions may run up to 730 days ahead.

rental_id.description: Rental ID returned by create_rental or list_rentals.

days.description: Rental term in days. Required for long-term quotes, purchases, and extensions.

tools.name: cancel_rental
tools.description: Cancel and request a refund before the rental cancel_deadline and before any code has arrived. Cancellation releases the number.

rental_id.description: Rental ID returned by create_rental or list_rentals.
